findings_summary: config_file must be relative to the config folder (agents/<name>.toml), fixed in the example
min(16, CPUs - 2) is the client's default cap, not a runtime ceiling; the setting accepts 1-256
.wslconfig processors counts logical processors; the 5975WX has 32 cores / 64 threads, so the plan moved to 60
the Codex thread cap does not mirror the Claude setting; separate client limits
